title: fix(cli): os serve reads OS_TRUSTED_APP_SCHEMES into AuthPlugin's trustedAppSchemes
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBSxT6HBZKBXR3X4SjZA56g8)_

Fixes #29972

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么:** `os serve` 新增读取环境变量 `OS_TRUSTED_APP_SCHEMES`(逗号分隔,逐项 trim、丢空项、去重,读法与 `OS_TRUSTED_ORIGINS` 相同),作为 `trustedAppSchemes` 传给它构建的 `new AuthPlugin({...})`。`os dev` / `os start` 都以继承的环境派生 `serve` 子进程,走同一行。文档 `environment-variables.mdx` 在 `OS_TRUSTED_ORIGINS` 旁加一行。
- **为什么改:** 18.3.0 的移动端登录交接(`GET /api/v1/auth/one-time-token/handoff`)只给已登记的 app scheme 发 token,而 `os serve` 没有任何设置能到达这个键,所以自托管部署对每个 app 都回 400,mobile#148 卡在这里。
- **风险与回滚:** 认证边界:登记一个 scheme 即决定谁能收到登录交接。未设置 = 维持现状(不登记任何 scheme,`one-time-token` 插件不挂载,交接对所有目标回 400),没有默认值。坏值不在读取处吞掉,由 plugin-auth 的 `assertTrustedAppSchemes` 在启动时报错并点名。只加环境变量,不加 stack 键。`@objectstack/cli` patch。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **先看:** `packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts` 的 `resolveTrustedAppSchemes` 与 `new AuthPlugin({` 里的 `trustedAppSchemes:` 一行;测试 `serve-auth-trusted-app-schemes.contract.test.ts`。
- **两分钟验证:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run src/commands/serve-auth-trusted-app-schemes.contract.test.ts`,预期 `12 passed`。
- **需要你做的:** 评审本 PR 的设置读法与"未设置不挂载"(认证边界,按 #29714 的先例由维护者过目)。

## What changes

- **`packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts`.** A new `resolveTrustedAppSchemes(env)` reads `OS_TRUSTED_APP_SCHEMES`: comma-separated, each entry trimmed, empty entries dropped, repeats folded, in the order typed. Unset, empty, or nothing but separators answers `undefined`. The `new AuthPlugin({...})` call passes `trustedAppSchemes: resolveTrustedAppSchemes(process.env)`.
  - **Unset stays unset.** There is no default scheme. With no scheme registered, plugin-auth mounts no `one-time-token` plugin and the hand-off route refuses every target, exactly as today.
  - **A bad entry still fails loudly.** The reader never validates, lower-cases or drops an entry. A bad one reaches `AuthManager`, where `assertTrustedAppSchemes` refuses it at construction, naming it.
  - **Every CLI door.** `serve.ts` is the only CLI file that constructs `AuthPlugin`. `os dev` (`dev.ts`, `localEnv` from `process.env`) and `os start` (`start.ts`, `localEnv` from `process.env`) spawn `serve` as a child with the inherited environment, so they read the variable through the same line. Measured below on an `os dev` boot.
- **`content/docs/deployment/environment-variables.mdx`.** One row for `OS_TRUSTED_APP_SCHEMES` directly under `OS_TRUSTED_ORIGINS`: what it registers, how it is read, that a bad entry fails the boot, and that unset leaves the plugin unmounted and the hand-off answering `400`.
- **Test inputs.** The new contract test reads that docs row, so `scripts/cross-package-test-inputs.mjs` and `turbo.json`'s `@objectstack/cli#test` inputs name the page (`check:cross-package-test-inputs`). `scripts/check-ci-filter-parity.mjs`'s rollback count moves 19 → 20 for that declaration, by name.
- **Env variable only.** No stack key is added: that would be a protocol key, which goes contract-first. The hosted runtime's own `AuthPlugin` (cloud) is not touched.
- **Declarations.** `Clause-②: no`. The new `resolveTrustedAppSchemes` and `TRUSTED_APP_SCHEMES_ENV_NAME` are named exports of `commands/serve.ts`, which the package entry does not re-export (`src/index.ts` exports only `ServeCommand`), and `serve.js` is not a published subpath (`exports`: `.`, `./console`, `./hook-body`). So the public surface does not widen. No input the CLI accepted before is refused: no reader of `OS_TRUSTED_APP_SCHEMES` existed (0 hits on main). `Metadata-protocol: none`. Changeset: `@objectstack/cli` patch.

## Tests

New `packages/cli/src/commands/serve-auth-trusted-app-schemes.contract.test.ts`, 12 cases, in the style of the sibling `serve-auth-*.contract.test.ts`:

- **Reader:** the variable name; unset answers `undefined`; `''`, `'   '`, `','`, `' , ,, '` answer `undefined`; one scheme; padded entries, empties and repeats; a bad entry (`Https`, `AI.Objectos.Mobile`) passes through as typed.
- **Reader into a real `AuthManager`:** a set value registers its schemes (`getRegisteredAppSchemes()`); unset registers none; `ai.objectos.mobile,myapp` fails construction with `invalid trustedAppSchemes: "myapp"`.
- **Construction scan** (`serve.ts`, comments masked): exactly one `new AuthPlugin(`, carrying `trustedAppSchemes:resolveTrustedAppSchemes(process.env),`; no second reader of the variable in `serve.ts`; the docs row sits directly under `OS_TRUSTED_ORIGINS`.

## Acceptance notes

Boot check on `examples/app-crm`, `objectstack dev --fresh -p N`, built CLI from this branch. Request: `GET /api/v1/auth/one-time-token/handoff?redirect_uri=ai.objectos.mobile%3A%2F%2Fauth%2Fcallback&code_challenge=<43 chars>&code_challenge_method=S256`.

| Boot | Request | Answer |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `OS_TRUSTED_APP_SCHEMES=' ai.objectos.mobile , '` (padded, trailing empty) | no session | `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` |
| same | signed in as the dev admin | `302`, `location: ai.objectos.mobile://auth/callback?token=…` |
| same | `redirect_uri=com.other.app://cb` | `400` "is not a registered app scheme" |
| unset | no session | `400` "is not a registered app scheme" |
| unset | signed in | `400` "is not a registered app scheme" |
| unset | `POST /api/v1/auth/one-time-token/verify` | `404` (plugin not mounted) |
| `OS_TRUSTED_APP_SCHEMES='ai.objectos.mobile,MyApp'` | — | boot exits 1: `✗ [auth] invalid trustedAppSchemes: "MyApp" is not a lowercase reverse-domain scheme …` |
| **ablated** (wiring line removed, CLI rebuilt), variable set | no session | `400` "is not a registered app scheme": the card's bug back |

## Verification

Measured on `objectstack-ai/objectstack@9049be26` (main at branch point) plus this branch.

<details><summary>Ablations (each red once, then restored)</summary>

- **A1: the `trustedAppSchemes:` line removed from `new AuthPlugin({`.** 1 of 12 red: `passes trustedAppSchemes from resolveTrustedAppSchemes(process.env)` (`expected '{secret,baseUrl,appName:resolveDeploy…' to contain 'trustedAppSchemes:resolveTrustedAppSc…'`). The same ablation on a rebuilt dist answered `400` on the live boot (table above).
- **A2: a default scheme when unset** (`return ['ai.objectos.mobile']`). 2 of 12 red: `unset stays unset: no default scheme` and `an unset variable registers none`.
- **A3: the reader silently drops an entry that does not look like a scheme.** 2 of 12 red: `passes a bad entry through as typed` and `a bad entry fails construction loudly, naming the entry` (`expected [Function] to throw an error`).
- Restored from the commit: 12/12 green; dist rebuilt and grepped (1 hit for the wiring line).

</details>

<details><summary>Builds, suites, lint and gates</summary>

- `pnpm exec turbo run build --concurrency=2` (whole workspace, under the verify lock): exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli test` (both tiers): 572 files passed, 1 skipped; 7012 tests passed, 9 skipped.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli run typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit` plus `check:test-typecheck`): exit 0. The first attempt was a tsc OOM on the shared box (exit null, no diagnostics); rerun with `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192`.
- `pnpm lint` (repo-wide): exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` on head `3b20bb01`: 111 commands, all exit 0, recorded with `--ran`: "111 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 111 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED". Also run, from the roster block: `check:auth-mount-ledger` and `check:changeset-fixed`, both exit 0.
- Two reds on the way, both fixed in this PR:
  - `check:cross-package-test-inputs`: the contract test reads `environment-variables.mdx`, which cli's declared inputs did not cover. The page now sits in `scripts/cross-package-test-inputs.mjs` and in `turbo.json`'s `@objectstack/cli#test` inputs, beside the `deployment/cli.mdx` the cli e2e tests already read.
  - `check:ci-filter-parity --self-test`: that declaration is one more glob the pre-#10015 `crosspkg` rollback uncovers, so its pinned count moves 19 → 20, recorded by name the way #14824 and #15818 recorded theirs.
- `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` needs its pinned fixture commit in a shallow clone; fetched, it exits 0 (48 cases).

</details>

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (No spec change.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [ ] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request. The branch is the harness-pinned `claude/project-thread-p09liv`, not `claude/issue-29972-*`. It is off current `main`, with one issue and one PR.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (Not touched.)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English. (Except the `维护者速读` section the dispatch asks for.)
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
